name: MemcardRequestState.MEMCARD_REQUEST_IDLE
role: g_memcard_request_state value 0: no request in flight; every finish path (finish label, PollFileCompletion's write / read completion, the -2 non-format path) stores it after posting g_memcard_request_status; memcard_StepRequest / PollFileCompletion do nothing in it
evidence: 28708.c:283-500 (memcard_StepRequest, memcard_PollFileCompletion, memcard_Update, memcard_Request*: the only C readers / writers; git grep finds no other TU); 28708.c:325, 408-410, 437, 454; memcard_Update keeps polling memcard_StepCardInfoAndLoad while the state is < 2 (0 or 1)

name: MemcardRequestState.MEMCARD_REQUEST_PROBE_CARD
role: g_memcard_request_state value 1: stored by every memcard_Request* (load / save / overwrite / format); memcard_Update runs memcard_StepCardInfoAndLoad (_card_info / _card_load) in it, and memcard_StepRequest routes its result: card ready -> 5 (load) / 3 (save, overwrite) / 7 (format); -1 retries up to 4 times, then status 8
evidence: 28708.c:283-500 (memcard_StepRequest, memcard_PollFileCompletion, memcard_Update, memcard_Request*: the only C readers / writers; git grep finds no other TU); 28708.c:290-335, 464-465, 472-500

name: MemcardRequestState.MEMCARD_REQUEST_WRITE_START
role: g_memcard_request_state value 3: memcard_StepRequest state_3 counts files / free blocks, builds the file header and save block in g_shared_buffer and starts memcard_WriteFile; on success steps to 4
evidence: 28708.c:283-500 (memcard_StepRequest, memcard_PollFileCompletion, memcard_Update, memcard_Request*: the only C readers / writers; git grep finds no other TU); 28708.c:315, 342-344, 352-381

name: MemcardRequestState.MEMCARD_REQUEST_WRITE_WAIT
role: g_memcard_request_state value 4: memcard_PollFileCompletion case 4 polls memcard_PollSwEvents for the write, closes g_memcard_fd and posts status 2 (ok) / 3 (error), back to 0 (its header comment: 4 = after a write)
evidence: 28708.c:283-500 (memcard_StepRequest, memcard_PollFileCompletion, memcard_Update, memcard_Request*: the only C readers / writers; git grep finds no other TU); 28708.c:380, 415-438

name: MemcardRequestState.MEMCARD_REQUEST_READ_START
role: g_memcard_request_state value 5: memcard_StepRequest state_5 checks the save file exists and starts memcard_ReadFile into g_shared_buffer; on success steps to 6

name: MemcardRequestState.MEMCARD_REQUEST_READ_WAIT
role: g_memcard_request_state value 6: memcard_PollFileCompletion case 6 polls the read, closes g_memcard_fd, restores the save block (memcard_RestoreSaveBlock) and posts status 5 / 0xF / 6, back to 0 (header comment: 6 = after a read)
